desc:
FIRE PLANES is a fast-paced aerial firefighting game where you combat massive wildfires using airplanes and helicopters!

🌊 Scoop water from lakes
🔥 Drop water on fires and protect towns
💸 Earn money by completing rounds
✈️ Buy new planes

🗺️ Maps are procedurally generated and change each round
🎮 Game Modes: 🏠 Realistic • 🛡️ Town Defense • 🔥 Mega Fire
